name: Azalea, Ace in the Hole
text: Once per Turn Action - 0: Put a card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck. If you do, put the top card of your deck face up into your arsenal. If it's an arrow card, it gains dominate until end of turn. Go again

name: Death Dealer
text: Once per Turn Action - {r}: If you have no cards in your arsenal, you may put an arrow card from your hand face up into your arsenal. If you do, draw a card. Go again

name: Crow's Nest
text:
Azalea Specialization
Whenever an arrow is put face up into your arsenal from your deck, you may pay {r}. If you do, put an aim counter on it.

name: Target Totalizer
text: Action - Destroy this: Whenever an arrow with an aim counter hits this turn, draw a card. Go again

name: Hidden Agenda
text:
Instant - Turn a face-down arrow in your arsenal face-up: Gain {r}. At the beginning of the end phase, destroy this.
Arcane Barrier 1

name: Sharp Shooters
text:
Action - Destroy this: Put an arrow from your hand face-up into your arsenal with an aim counter. Go again
Battleworn

name: Flight Path
text:
Attack Reaction - Destroy this: Target arrow attack with an aim counter gets go again.
Battleworn

name: Barbed Undertow
text: If Barbed Undertow has an aim counter, it gains "When this hits a hero, choose red, yellow, or blue. Until the start of your next turn, they can't pitch cards of the chosen color."

name: Bolt'n' Shot
text: If Bolt'n' Shot's {p} is greater than its base {p}, it has go again and "If this hits, reload."

name: Drill Shot
text:
If Drill Shot has an aim counter, it has piercing 1.
When this hits a hero, put a -1{d} counter on an equipment they control.

name: Infecting Shot
text:
If Infecting Shot has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control.

name: Ravenous Rabble
text:
When this attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. This gets -X{p}, where X is the pitch value of the card revealed this way.
Go again

name: Red in the Ledger
text:
Azalea Specialization
If Red in the Ledger hits a hero, they can't play or activate more than 1 action during their next turn.

name: Sedation Shot
text:
If Sedation Shot has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, create an Inertia token under their control.

name: Sleep Dart
text: If Sleep Dart hits a hero, they lose all hero card effects and activated abilities until the end of their next turn.

name: Stone Rain
text: If this has an aim counter, it gets dominate and "When this hits a hero, they banish face-down a card from their hand. At the beginning of their next end phase, they return it to their hand."

name: Lace with Bloodrot
text:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control."
Go again

name: Lace with Frailty
text:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create a Frailty token under their control."
Go again

name: Lace with Inertia
text:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create an Inertia token under their control."
Go again

name: Point the Tip
text:
Target face up arrow in your arsenal gains +3{p} until end of turn. Put an aim counter on it.
Go again

name: Read the Glide Path
text:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +3{p}.
Opt 1
Go again

name: Scout the Periphery
text:
Look at the top card of target hero's deck.
The next attack action card you play from arsenal this turn gains +3{p}.
Go again

name: Spire Sniping
text: When Spire Sniping is put or turned face up in arsenal, look at the top 2 cards of your deck, then put them back in any order.

name: Line It Up
text:
Your next arrow attack this turn gets +3{p}.
You may turn a face-down arrow in your arsenal face-up. If you do, put an aim counter on it.
Go again

name: Read the Glide Path
text:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +2{p}.
Opt 1
Go again

name: Memorial Ground
text: Put target attack action card with cost 1 or less from your graveyard on top of your deck.

name: Infecting Shot
text:
If Infecting Shot has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control.

name: Spire Sniping
text: When Spire Sniping is put or turned face up in arsenal, look at the top 2 cards of your deck, then put them back in any order.

name: Nock the Deathwhistle
text:
Azalea Specialization
Search your deck for an arrow card, reveal it, then shuffle your deck and put it on top of your deck.
Reload
Go again

name: Bloodrot Pox
text: At the beginning of your end phase, destroy Bloodrot Pox, then it deals 2 damage to you unless you pay {r}{r}{r}.

name: Frailty
text:
Your attack action cards played from arsenal and weapon attacks have -1{p}.
At the beginning of your end phase destroy Frailty.

name: Inertia
text: At the beginning of your end phase, destroy Inertia, then put all cards from your hand and arsenal on the bottom of your deck.
